title: Gap Classification
description: DISCOVER-stage artifact. Output of gap-classifier. Classifies research gaps into one of 7 typed categories via the deterministic classify_gap.py tool. An empty gaps array is allowed (a clean literature set may yield zero classifiable gaps). Every present gap carries a non-blank reason_code and at least one non-blank evidence_ref (anti-slop): a gap with no real evidence is schema-rejected. The optional derived_from carries the provenance signals (which gap-hunters flagged this gap) forward so the novelty-scorer can aggregate them deterministically.

gaps.description: Classified research gaps; each present gap must carry at least one non-blank evidence_ref.

gap_type.description: The 7-type gap taxonomy, determined deterministically by classify_gap.py.

reason_code.description: Deterministic code from classify_gap.py identifying the distinguishing signal, e.g. FW_STATED, WEAK_LOCUS. Must be non-blank.

evidence_ref.description: Evidence pointers (source_refs / paper_note ids) supporting this gap (anti-slop). At least one required; each must be non-blank.

derived_from.description: Optional provenance signals (e.g. future_work, white_space_present, weakness_opportunity) carried forward from the gap-hunters that flagged this gap. The novelty-scorer aggregates these; an empty/absent list means the only provenance is the classifier's own reason_code.

source_kind.description: Optional provenance kind of the gap signal.
